risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the PS4 home screen showing the Games/Library list (or Settings > Storage > Games) with the installed titles visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS4 with 1 controller and no verified pre-installed games.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model (Fat/ Slim/ Pro) and condition (wear, possible overheating) are not fully verifiable from these angles.
risks.proof: Photo of the console rear label/model number (CUH-xxxx) and a short video of the console booting to the home screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used PS4 (worst-case within the PS4 range) with unknown condition.

risks.risk: Controller authenticity/condition (drift, button issues) and whether it’s the only pad are not testable remotely.
risks.proof: Video test: show controller connected and demonstrate movement in a game/menu; also show all buttons responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 1 pad with untested functionality.

risks.risk: Cables/accessories are not shown; could be missing power/HDMI.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller charging cable if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + 1 controller only (no guaranteed cables).

proof_requests: Rear label photo showing the exact PS4 model number (CUH-xxxx).
Short boot-to-home-screen video (showing it turns on and reaches the PS4 menu).
Photo/video of the installed games list showing the titles and that there are 10 pre-installed games.
Photo of all included items laid out (power cable, HDMI, any other accessories).
Controller test video showing button presses and joystick movement.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS4 and one controller, but they do not verify the key pricing drivers claimed by the seller (10 pre-installed games and specific titles) or the exact PS4 model/accessories. Without that, a reliable worst-case price pick from the comparables isn’t possible.
